contexts.text: By a beryl, as the rest of the body appeared, namely, the middle body between the head and the loins (), is signified the good of charity and of faith, for a beryl is a precious stone which flashes.

A beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper () = the spiritual love of truth, in which higher things cease... The colour of all the stones of this order approaches to bright white from azure. That a beryl = the spiritual love of truth is evident from... Ezekiel; The look of the wheels [was like] unto the appearance of a beryl stone. The wheels of the cherubim have a similar signification to the arms and feet of man, namely, the power of acting and advancing, which is of truth from good. Hence it is that their look was like the appearance of a beryl stone (), for a beryl = truth from spiritual good, which possesses power.

In Daniel... The body = the good of celestial love, and also the good of spiritual love, and its External = truth from that good. Hence it is that his body appeared like a beryl (); thus that a beryl = the truth of spiritual love.
